title: Phoenix 799 carbon electric-assist bicycle specification
notes: The current product page identifies Phoenix model and item number 799. It lists a carbon frame, 20 kg vehicle quality, a 9-speed transmission, 36 V with separate 6 Ah and 10 Ah choices, 250 W motor claim, disc brakes and a non-folding layout; its detail text calls the frame T700 carbon. The page does not tie the retained 700C card to one battery option, state weight measurement conditions, publish maximum tire clearance or provide controlled stiffness evidence. Its displayed international price is not used as mainland checkout evidence.
